description: Resolve a named aicut recipe and read its instructions without executing it. Entries include image/video recipes. For an explicit slash invocation, pass its recipe `name` without the slash before selecting tools or requesting media. A message whose request is a `HANDOFF: handoff_id=<uuid>` line was too long to open whole from the aicut site: pass that id as handoff_id, without name, to receive the user's full request, then follow it. Recipes supply their generation workflow. It is a guide, never the user's go: every paid call in it still needs its own price and ask.

handoff_id.description: The id from a `HANDOFF: handoff_id=<uuid>` line in the user's message. Returns the full request it stands for; omit name.

name: get_recipe
title: Get a step-by-step recipe
